name: Gothic Night
summary: Moonlit cursed churchyard in detailed pixel art: a banded light map darkens a cold world; only faces, lanterns and candles glow warm.
description: A cold, desaturated night in detailed 1:1 pixel art: mossy gravestones, dead trees, cobble paths and leaf litter under drifting mist. Everything is painted fully lit in muted blue-grey, purple and moss ramps, then a per-frame banded light map (moonlight ambient + vignette + warm point lights) is multiplied over it. The only warm colours are the flickering carved pumpkin face of the main character, lanterns, seeds and candles, and creatures keep tiny emissive eyes that pierce the dark.

difficulty.why: Every new asset is painted per pixel from shaded shapes into 3–7 step ramps with Bayer dither, outlined, and needs its own emissive pixel list and often a matching banded light sprite; it must stay readable inside the dark light map, so dark-yet-readable is a constant balancing act.

technique.resolution: 1 art pixel = 1 world unit: the 360-unit-tall view is a 360-row buffer, integer upscale up = max(1, round(screenH / 360)), nearest neighbour. Sprites are baked once into small canvases; ground chunks of 256 × 256 px are generated per pixel in time slices.
technique.summary: Sprites are painted per pixel from shaded shapes (sphere normals lit by one moon direction), quantised into hand-made ramps with Bayer-8 dither and wrapped in a #0b0910 outline. A light map canvas (ambient #687cb2 with banded vignette, drifting cloud light, banded point-light sprites) is multiplied onto the ground at 100 % and onto characters and props at 55 %, then bloom is added with 'lighter' and emissive pixels are drawn unlit on top.
technique.linework: 1-px near-black outline #0b0910 around every sprite (4-neighbour), added by a pass after painting; ghosts use a cool #141a2e outline, gems #061c24, seeds #2a1606, emphasised number digits #2a0606. No outlines on ground textures; ground forms are separated by dark mortar/gap pixels and cast shadows.
technique.shading: Ramp quantisation: tone = 0.45 + shade(normal) * 0.42, picked from 3–7 step ramps with Bayer-8 dither (strength 0.3–0.5). Light comes from the upper left (normalised -0.52, -0.64, 0.56); tone canvases add +0.17 on left edges, +0.1 top, −0.15 right, −0.08 bottom. Colour transitions (purple top into cream body) are dithered.
technique.lighting: Per-frame light map: ambient moonlight rgb(104,124,178), 5-band dithered vignette down to 50 %, drifting dark cloud texture added, then point lights as banded radial sprites (main character 96 × 78 warm, lanterns 42 × 34, candles 34 × 26, red grave lights 20 × 15, cyan gems, pale ghost glows, green giant cores). Lights flicker with noise (0.86 ± 0.14). Multiplied onto ground (alpha 1) and sprites (alpha 0.55).
technique.texture: Ground is per-pixel procedural: dithered soil, grass tufts revealed by per-pixel thresholds against a coverage field (dark rim where they end), sorted leaf litter with drop shadows, Worley cobbles and flagstone slabs with lit top-left edges, 3/4-view cast shadows from the row above. Decals: skulls, bones, candle stubs, puddles, grave mounds, roots, cracks, dead flowers.

paletteRules: Author every colour fully lit; the light map turns it into night. Never pre-darken sprites.
Cold, desaturated ramps (blue-grey, violet, moss, plum) for 90% of the image; warm orange/yellow only on light sources and emissive details.
Emissive colours (carved face, eyes, flames, embers, gems, wisps, floating numbers) are drawn after the light pass and are the brightest pixels on screen.
Each material gets its own 3–7 step ramp; tones are picked with Bayer-8 dither, never blended.
Creature families are identified by eye colour: toxic green root creatures, cyan ghosts, green-cored giants.
Outlines are always near-black #0b0910, never pure black and never coloured (except cool ghost/gem outlines).

world.summary: A moonlit moor and churchyard generated per pixel: biome fields (grass, moss, leaf litter, cobble paths, flagstone plazas, graveyard density) are sampled on an 8-px grid and interpolated; each layer reveals its own tileable 256² texture where a per-pixel threshold falls below the field value, so edges break into single tufts, stones and leaves. Ground textures have no outlines and are authored fully lit in cold ramps, then darkened by the light map.
layers: Soil: dithered 6-step ramp (#1e171c…#69574e) from two fbm octaves, 1500 lit pebble dots and 110 pebbles of 2–3 px cobble tones

Grass / moss: 5200 blades (2–4 px, brightening upward) and a per-tuft threshold (Worley clumps + fbm) against the grass coverage field; pixels within 0.035 of the threshold are darkened × 0.72 for a rim; moss replaces grass where the moss field > 0.57
Dead leaves: 2900 tiny 4–6-px leaf shapes per tile in 4 families (rust, ochre, plum, ash), sorted by threshold, each casting a 1-px offset shadow (× 0.72)

Flagstones (plazas) and cobbles (paths): slabs 15–30 px wide in rows 12–17 px tall, Worley stones with a lit top-left edge and dark gaps, per-stone thresholds; 3/4-view cast shadow × 0.62 on the row below, grass over soil × 0.8
Global brightness 0.9–1.1 and slight hue drift from low-frequency fbm

Decals baked into the chunk: grave mounds, open graves, roots around trees, puddles with moon reflection, floor slabs with engraved crosses, cracks, moss patches, skulls and bones, candle stubs, dead flowers, twigs, single leaves
Per frame: two drifting banded mist layers (alpha ≤ 0.2 and 0.12), then the light map multiply
Loose leaves, stones and twigs gather in drifts and clusters (low-frequency noise), the rest of the ground stays calm instead of an even sprinkle.

characters.summary: All characters are painted per pixel from shaded ellipses lit from the upper left, quantised into ramps with Bayer dither and wrapped in a 1-px #0b0910 outline; eyes and faces are emissive pixels drawn after the light. The main character is a 22 × 34 px sprite (24 × 36 with outline): a 15 × 13 ribbed pumpkin head with a 28-pixel carved glowing face, a wine scarf whose tail flutters through 4 positions, a violet trapezoid cloak with a lit left edge, two dark folds and a ragged hem, dark trousers and boots. Creatures: a small purple-and-cream root creature with a leafy top and green glowing eyes (20 × 26), a fast skeletal ghost with a dithered dissolving tail and cyan eyes drawn at 86 % alpha (27 × 28), and a large cracked root giant with gnarled arms and a glowing green diamond core (46 × 54).
rules: Paint shapes per pixel: ellipse + sphere-normal shading + ramp pick with Bayer dither, then a 1-px #0b0910 outline (ghosts #141a2e)
Big readable head (about 40% of the height) carrying the main character's colour identity
Faces and eyes are emissive pixel lists drawn after the light so they read in the dark; one eye colour per creature family
4-frame walks, 2-frame idles, mirrored canvases for facing
Feet anchor at the outline's bottom row; shadows are dithered ellipses (main character 8 × 2.5, small 6 × 2, large 15 × 4, ghost 4 × 1.5)
Every figure that should be found in the dark gets a light sprite or a glow (main character warm 96 × 78, ghost pale blue, giant green core)
Small creatures ~20–30 px, large creatures ~45–55 px; floating creatures dissolve at the bottom with Bayer dither

props.summary: Churchyard props painted per pixel on a tone canvas (material id + tone per pixel, edge rules +0.17 left, +0.1 top, −0.15 right, −0.08 bottom) from the stone, moss, bark, iron and wax ramps, outlined in #0b0910, and each baked with a sheared moon shadow toward the lower right.
rules: Gravestones: 9 shapes (round, arch, cross, obelisk, broken, wide, small…) × 3 tilts (0, −0.09, +0.08), lit front face 0.42 + 0.2 × height, 2-px extruded side/top, engraved crosses as dark groove + lit lip, cracks, moss on top and bottom 4 rows
Celtic ring crosses (24 × 38), broken pillars (22 × 36, jagged top, rubble) and weeping angels (34 × 50, wings, bowed head, weathering streaks) use the same stone system
Dead trees (70 × 92): recursive branches (depth ≤ 4, ≤ 220 segments) stamped as discs, flared roots, knot hole, bark ramp with strong left light (+0.32)
Iron fences with spear-tipped bars between capped stone posts; candle clusters of 3–5 wax candles with 3-frame 1–2-px flames and a 34 × 26 warm light
Red glass grave lights on 1 in 6 graves with a 20 × 15 red light and red bloom
Moon shadow: every opaque pixel at height h is copied to (x + 0.55h, 1 + 0.3h) in [5, 5, 12], 2 px tall, drawn at alpha 0.42
Props are y-sorted with the characters and receive the 55 % light-map darkening

effects.name: Flickering carved face
effects.how: An expanding broken ember circle (r 4–40, y squashed 1.25): warm dashes with gaps carrying six small ember crosses, over 0.6 s, with 18 embers and 4 wisps — never a plain circle.

effects.name: Ember trail
effects.how: Single 1-px particles rising from the pumpkin head every 0.16 s, wobbling ±1 px, colour stepping down the fire ramp #fff2b8 → #7a1c06 with life; drawn emissive.

effects.name: Seed projectile
effects.how: 9 × 9 cream seed baked in 16 rotations with #2a1606 outline, 4-pixel trail #ffc848 #ff8a1c #c8460c #7a1c06 at 3 + 2.2j px behind, a 14 × 11 warm light and a small additive bloom.

effects.name: Impact burst and vanish
effects.how: Root creatures spray juice pixels (#3a0a26…#bc3068) and white/yellow sparks; ghosts burst into frost sparks (#dffaff #a8e8ff #ffffff) and mist; vanishing flashes the sprite white for 0.18 s, half-alpha to 0.4 s, plus a white 15 × 13 light and 2–3-px chunks; a teal wisp (7 × 12, dithered tail) rises with its own 14 × 14 light.

effects.name: Collectible gems
effects.how: 6 × 8 (large 8 × 11) teal diamonds with a #061c24 outline, a glint running down the left facet over 4 frames, each with a 10 × 8 (22 × 18) cyan light; collecting shows a cross-shaped #e8fffa glint with 4 outer dots.

effects.name: Orbiting lanterns
effects.how: 13 × 15 purple/cream root lanterns on an iron handle with 3-frame fire-ramp eyes and mouth, a 42 × 34 warm light and bloom, drawn emissive and swaying ±1 px.

effects.name: Emerge
effects.how: Ground creatures rise out of the soil (sprite revealed bottom-up with outQuad) above an outlined dirt heap; ghosts fade in from a mist puff while sinking 8 px into place.

effects.name: Ring burst
effects.how: Ellipse rings (radius 4…40 in steps of 3, y squashed 1.25) in rgb(255,230,170) expand over 0.6 s, with 18 embers and 4 wisps.

atmosphere.summary: One per-frame light map creates the night: ambient moonlight rgb(104,124,178) with a 5-band dithered vignette, drifting banded cloud light and posterised point-light sprites, multiplied onto the ground at alpha 1 and onto characters and props at alpha 0.55, followed by small additive bloom and an unlit emissive pass. Two banded mist layers and dithered or sheared shadows complete the mood.
rules: Light-map base: vignette v = smoothstep(0.5, 1.12, dist) normalised by (0.6 W, 0.62 H), centre 6 px above the middle, posterised to 5 bands with ±0.4 Bayer dither, f = 1 − v × 0.5
Cloud light: tileable banded texture rgb(22,26,38) at 512 px scale added with 'lighter', drifting (7, 3) px/s

Point lights are banded radial sprites (falloff (1 − d)^pow posterised with dithered band edges): main character 96 × 78 7 bands, lantern 42 × 34, candle 34 × 26, grave light 20 × 15 red, projectile 14 × 11, gems 10 × 8 / 22 × 18 cyan, ghost 16 × 13 pale blue at 0.5, giant core 36 × 29 green
Flicker = 0.86 + 0.09 × noise(7.3t) + 0.05 × sin(23t); warm light stays rare so the main character remains the focal glow
Bloom: small banded sprites (warm 11 × 10 at 0.32, candle 6 × 6, red 6 × 5, green 12 × 12, cyan 5 × 5) added with 'lighter'
Shadows: dithered ellipses in [6, 6, 14] at alpha 120 under sprites; props cast sheared moon shadows [5, 5, 12] at 0.42 toward the lower right
Mist: two banded fog textures rgb(196,208,232) at max alpha 0.2 / 0.12, scale 2 and 1, drifting (5, 1.5) and (−7, 2) px/s, drawn before the light
Red flash tint: light base multiplied at flashT × 0.35 plus #6a0010 at flashT × 0.18, with a red 60 × 50 light

ui.summary: Iron-framed bars and boxes (2-px grey frame, 2-px black outline, inset black line, hard drop shadow), pixel numbers in Silkscreen with hard black shadows, blackletter labels in warm #f0a850. A full-width teal top bar with 30-px separators, a 236 × 18 red bar with a pixel heart, a clipped-corner clock box and a skull counter. Cards look like tarot cards: navy-violet radial background, tarnished gold double border, pixel corner ornaments, arched icon window, Pirata One names and italic IM Fell English descriptions.

motion: Main character: 8 walk poses at the walk animation rate, 2 idle frames alternating at 1.6 Hz (bob ±1 px), scarf tail cycles 4 positions.
Small creatures: 4 frames (bob 0/−1, tilt ±1, leaves sway ±7°, alternate root-leg lifts) at anim × 1.6; large creatures 4 frames at anim × 2.
Ghosts: 4 frames at 7 fps (tail wave phase, arm reach 0–2 px), hover 4 px plus a ±1.5 px sine at 3 rad/s, drawn at 86% alpha with a 3-pixel icy trail.
Lights flicker continuously (noise + 23 rad/s sine); lanterns cycle 3 eye frames at 10 fps and sway ±1 px.
Gems cycle a glint down the facet in 4 frames at 5 fps (frame 3 held), bob ±1 px; candle flames 3 frames at 9 fps.
Floating numbers pop up 2 px in the first 0.1 s, then fade in 3 alpha steps (1, 0.66, 0.33).
Mist layers drift slowly (5 and −7 px/s horizontally); cloud light drifts at (7, 3) px/s.

Main character: 8 walk poses (contact, down, passing, up × 2) at ~12 fps with the head landing one frame after the body and the glove counter-swinging; 4 idle breath poses on a 1.1 s beat with the head following 0.14 s later.
Ghosts float on an eased lift [0,0,1,2,3,3,2,1] px at 5 fps; every creature has its own phase; hits add a 2-px knock-back for ~130 ms.
Disappear: a pale flash, then ground creatures are dragged back into the grave soil behind the dirt heap (inQuad) while ghosts rise and thin out.
do: Paint sprites per pixel from lit shapes and quantise into ramps with Bayer-8 dither.
Author colours fully lit and let one multiplied light map create the night.
Give the main character a large warm light and put all warm colour on light sources.
Draw eyes, faces, flames, gems and numbers after the light pass so they glow.
Use banded (posterised + dithered) light falloff, never smooth gradients.
Outline every sprite with #0b0910 and give props a sheared moon shadow toward the lower right.
Break material borders into single tufts, stones and leaves using per-pixel thresholds.
dont: Don't make the world pitch black: ambient moonlight is ~45% brightness blue, and sprites only get 55% of the darkening.
Don't use saturated or warm colours on ordinary surfaces.
Don't use smooth radial gradients or blur for lights and fog.
Don't draw emissive details before the light pass (they would be darkened).
Don't use hard material borders or tile repetition on the ground.
Don't add pure #000000 outlines or thick linework.
Don't overlap too many warm lights — the main character must stay the brightest point.
Don’t scatter single leaves and pebbles evenly everywhere, and don’t use plain 1-px circles for big moments.
performance: Init is heavy: six 256² tileable ground textures, ~30 gravestones, 4 trees, all character frames, ~20 light sprites, fog and cloud textures are baked once. Ground chunks are generated per pixel in a generator that yields every 16 rows (biome fields on an 8-px grid, bilinear). Per frame: one light-map rebuild (copy + cloud tiles + one drawImage per light), two full-buffer multiplies, a handful of bloom blits, and per-pixel fillRects for eyes/embers. Keep point lights to a few dozen and reuse the light-map canvas.
